notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sanctum Weaver.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat for infinite blue mana.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may activate Sanctum Weaver an infinitely large number of times, adding infinite colored mana.
